components.name: Selected Stock
components.description: Choose a synthetic stock replay; selected state is also programmatic.
components.css: .ds-stock{font-family:'DM Sans Variable','Segoe UI',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid #99af8c;background:#f0f5e9;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease-out,color .16s ease-out}.ds-stock strong{font-size:10px;font-weight:600}.ds-stock span{font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-top:3px}.ds-stock:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e7efdf}.ds-stock:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--green);outline-offset:4px}.ds-stock:disabled{opacity:.46;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-stock{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: A light, calm learning workspace places market evidence alongside an explicit risk plan. Compact labels and generous panel separation support deliberate reading; a single dark action button anchors each task.
keyCharacteristics: Paper canvas and flat white analytical panels
Chart and setup evidence beside a risk ticket

rules.name: Flat analytical surfaces
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and single-pixel borders; the implemented interface has no shadows.

dos: Do keep risk and estimated fees close to the order action.
Do retain visible navigation labels and keyboard focus.
Do identify synthetic and rule-based teaching examples.
donts: Don't present synthetic outcomes as live-market accuracy or guaranteed income.
Don't add urgency or autoplay to the deliberate replay interaction.
